expectations.text: Skill does NOT run any CLI command
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Ran remove commands for both [track versions].' — baseline executed CLI commands after finding two matching tracks via WebSearch.

expectations.text: Skill asks for a Spotify URL/URI/ID via AskUserQuestion
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Did NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask for the URL.' Baseline resolved the track ID itself via WebSearch instead.

expectations.text: Skill does NOT invent or guess a track ID
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Used WebSearch to find Spotify track ID — found two versions (original + DaBaby collab). Did NOT refuse to guess the track ID.' Baseline effectively guessed the track ID by searching.

claims.claim: Baseline found two versions of the track (original + DaBaby collab) introducing ambiguity
claims.evidence: Transcript: 'Used WebSearch to find Spotify track ID — found two versions (original + DaBaby collab). Offered both options to user — ambiguous.'

claims.claim: Baseline ran remove commands for both versions
claims.evidence: Transcript: 'Ran remove commands for both — SKIP in dev mode.'

eval_feedback.overall: Maximum discrimination (0/3 vs 3/3). The baseline's WebSearch fallback introduces real risk of removing the wrong track version — exactly the problem the skill's guardrail prevents.
